messages.出血の付与は他の人格に任せ、S2・S3で攻撃レベル減少を入れるデバッファー。対象: A debuffer that leaves Bleed application to allies and inflicts Offense Level Down with S2 and S3. At enemy Bleed thresholds of 7 and 10, he can leave Offense Level Down, Attack Power Down, and Plus Coin Drop for the next turn to help allies clash.
messages.出血を条件にしたデバフ: S3「墨雲裂割」はⅠ・Ⅱコインで攻撃レベル減少1を付与: **Bleed-conditioned debuffs**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ of S3 Shadowcloud Shattercleave inflict 1 Offense Level Down, plus 1 more next turn if the target has at least 7 Bleed. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn if the target has at least 7 Bleed (10 or more at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅱ of S2 Shadow Cloud inflicts 1 Offense Level Down, plus 1 Attack Power Down next turn if the target has at least 10 Bleed.
messages.出血7以上でマッチ威力増加: 対象の出血7以上で、S1「雲斬り」のマッチ威力+2: **Clash Power Up at 7+ Bleed**: If the target has at least 7 Bleed, S1 Lenticular Rend gains +2 Clash Power (+1 at lower Uptie), S2 +2, and S3 +1. S3 gains +1 Coin Power at 10 or more Bleed. Together with his high minimum rolls, he is strong in battles starting at 0 SP.
messages.自前の出血付与は少なめ: S1はマッチ勝利時に出血1、Ⅰコインで出血回数+1。S: **His own Bleed infliction is modest**: S1 inflicts 1 Bleed on Clash Win and +1 Bleed Count with Coin Ⅰ. S2 inflicts 2 Bleed on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit, and S3 inflicts 3 Bleed on Coin Ⅲ Heads Hit. The combat passive Dark Cloud Blade (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) inflicts 1 Bleed on Clash Win (3 times per turn; it does not trigger on one-sided attacks).
messages.サポートパッシブ「黒雲剣法」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も低い: **Support passive — Dark Cloud Style (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 slowest ally lands an attack on an enemy with at least 7 Bleed (10 or more at lower Uptie), it inflicts 1 Offense Level Down next turn (3 times per turn).
messages.出血や出血回数を付与する味方と組んで、敵の出血を7以上に保つ。そのうえで出血の多: Pair him with allies who inflict Bleed and Bleed Count to keep enemy Bleed at 7 or more. Then land S2 and S3 on heavily bleeding enemies to weaken their attacks next turn. S3 does almost nothing against enemies without Bleed, so check the Bleed amount before using it. S1's 1 Bleed and Dark Cloud Blade only trigger on Clash Win, so use them in Clashes when you want to add Bleed.
